translation: ⟨I⟩ will remember ⟨the⟩ acts of YHWH; for ⟨I⟩ will remember ⟨the⟩ wonders of old, Your miracle.

tokens.rationale: The verb form implies 'I will remember'; English requires pronoun.
Literally 'acts' or 'deeds'; Hebrew lacks definite article, so added.
Shortened form of the sacred name; rendered as YHWH.
Conjunction indicating causal or explanatory relationship.
Repeated verb form; English requires pronoun.
Literally 'Your wonder/act'; context suggests 'miracle' fits best.
